profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Menlo Security Inc.
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer II at Menlo Security with 9+ years of experience building and scaling backend services and petabyte scale big data pipeline in a hyper-growth Bay Area startup. I’ve been part of a company’s growth from ~$1–2M to $140M+ ARR, navigating the complex technical challenges that come with scaling cloud-native systems to support 5–6 million daily active users. This includes designing and optimizing distributed systems under tight SLAs, delivering new product features end-to-end on aggressive timelines, and solving performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency issues at scale. These experiences have shaped me into an engineer who can operate effectively under pressure, architect scalable infrastructure, and make pragmatic trade-offs to deliver resilient, high-impact systems.

Joining Menlo straight out of grad school, I’ve grown alongside the company and contributed to nearly every major backend components involving Menlo’s policy and enforcement engine. From building petabyte-scale data pipelines to leading cross-functional engineering projects, my work has consistently focused on shipping scalable, reliable, and secure systems.

I’ve led teams, written critical production code in various modern programming languages, mentored engineers, and worked directly with customers and partners to solve deep technical challenges. My strength lies in bridging hands-on engineering with strategic thinking — whether it’s scaling systems, reducing costs, or simplifying complex problems to move projects forward.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Tech Lead & Core Developer for Menlo Security’s Inline CASB product, built from the ground up to enable real-time cloud app visibility and control.
• Designed and scaling Menlo Security’s production big data pipeline, processing billions of realtime log events daily for millions of global users. (~4PB, millions of customer facing queries per day) - Apache Kafka, Apache Druid, Fluentd (td-agent) and a lot of creativity)
• Core contributor to critical backend components like the Policy Server and Policy Enforcement engine, supporting fine-grained access control at scale.
• Built and maintained Analytics & Reporting systems, enabling deep visibility into user behavior and system activity.
• Developed customer-facing RESTful APIs for logging, policy management, and reporting — powering integrations across enterprise environments.
• Architected petabyte-scale log delivery systems using Apache Kafka Connect, AWS S3, SQS, and Lambda, ensuring high-throughput and fault-tolerant data export to customer destinations.
• Led cost optimization and automation efforts, saving $2M+ annually through strategic infrastructure redesign of data pipeline.
• Designed and implemented secure M2M JWT based authentication for log pipeline services using GCP Cloud KMS (asymmetric crypto), NGINX with Lua, and GCP Cloud Armor — securing data access across multi-tenant environments.
• Mentoring engineers on multiple teams and providing technical guidance to help them unlock their full potential.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Back-end APIs development (Python - NodeJS)
- Designed, developed and optimized back-end services responsible for Menlo Security's customer facing security policies. (Policy storage, distribution and enforcement) 
- Developed and maintained  back-end components for Reporting team for Cloud as well as on-prem Menlo Security products. (Analytics, Customer Reports, Log Delivery etc.)
- Highly involved in improving and optimizing Menlo's URL categorization service (milisecond level response time with billions of daily requests)
- Architected and maintained data pipeline for a large amount of log data. (Apache Druid, Fluentd, Apache Kafka, Apache Zookeeper)
- Solving complex scalability problems in the fast-growing startup.
- Built monitoring systems, alerts and health check components for crucial services.
- Data recovery tools development, CLI development, etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
The Apcera trusted cloud platform is a highly secure, policy-driven platform for cloud-native applications and microservices—as well as legacy applications. Apcera lets dev and DevOps teams use any modern tool or software they want while giving IT the assurance that their infrastructure is safe and secure. 

My Contributions: 

• Worked on YACC in Golang to generate parser for manifest files.(Manifest files are used for creating new jobs or apps in Apcera cluster)

• Contributed in development of API server to add new functionalities which delegates requests from Apcera CLI tool to other system components.

• Developed new commands and flags in APC  (Apcera's Command Line Interface) to interact with Apcera cluster for various operations.

• Contributed in Ruby automation scripts. Automated end-to-end installation of Apcera Community Edition - https://www.apcera.com/community-edition

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Contributed in Seagate Cloud Storage team by developing production ready code components  and  Proof of Concepts.

• Designed and developed Service Level Agreement violation detection engine.

• Developed Python scripts/RESTful APIs for report generation on demand in different file formats and automated generated report storage into Seagate cloud.

• Designed logic for refresh authentication token while uploading big files (GBs or TBs) into system. Scenario - ' user should not be logged out after 1 hour (default session time out of system) of active session, new auth token should be generated to keep user active during uploading big files which can take more than an hour to be uploaded'.

 Solution - Developed new RESTful services in web and auth components to meet the requirements.

• Contributed in unit test cases, code optimization and code modularization.

• Worked on bottle, Django frameworks for RESTful APIs development in Python.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Actively involved in all phases of software development cycle - requirement gathering, analysis, design, development of business logic and code optimization for a web tool used by General Electric(GE)'s Power staff and their customers.

Responsible for developing back-end Java services to provide business logic to web tool.

• Developed web tool to create long term maintenance contracts of equipments and services related to Energy Management.

• Implemented prediction logic for calculating schedule and finance for contracts in particular time span.

• Optimized performance and reduced the time to calculate schedule and finance up to 20%.
 Utilized Java, Spring framework and Hibernate for persistent layer.

• Developed e-commerce website which includes product search using ApacheSolr integration, product cart, order management and payment module integration using Java, Spring framework and Hybris components. 

• Responsible for analysis and design, development of Business Logic and optimization.

positions.title: Assistant Systems Engineer - Trainee
positions.description:
• Trained on Java,Servlets,JSP, HTML,CSS, JavaScript, SQL.
• Developed Inventory Management System using JSP, Servlets and MySQL for persistent layer.
• Focused on coding standards, team work and version control using SVN.

projects.title: Social Innovation – Team "Live wires"
projects.description:
Participated in “Opportunity Hack”, a hackathon, organized by eBay/PayPal.

The data of social welfare activities, done by eBay/PayPal employees, was maintained manually in  excel file. It was scattered and no system was available to fetch and consolidate the data.

To solve the problem, we created a portal that allows users to upload the excel sheets to a central database. An authorized user can also use the portal to generate/view individual or consolidated reports.

The web portal consumes RESTful web services built for login, report generation and excel upload modules. The modular architecture allows the system to incorporate enhancements easily.

Used Spring Web Services, Spring Boot, Gradle, MySQL and Bootstrap.

projects.title: Yogurtland Runner Game - Greenfoot
projects.description:
The Yogurtland Runner is a 2D Game ,developed in Greenfoot, applying the Software Design Patterns.
The project aimed at imparting knowledge in 2 major areas - 

     • How Sprint Planning works
     • How Software Design Patterns are implemented in Java.
	
The 2D game was implemented using the following Software Design Patterns - 
	 • Abstract Factory 
	 • Observer 
	 • Facade  
	 • Flyweight 
	 • Strategy Patterns
